title: Analytics
intro: What the catalog holds, how fresh it is and how the sources behave. Every figure shows what it is counted against.

snapshot.refreshFailed: The last recalculation failed. Showing the previous snapshot.

scope.regionNote: The region is the company's, not the delivery region.

hints.offers: Current offers, latest version only, deleted ones excluded.
hints.companies: Unique companies linked to these offers.
hints.fresh: Last observation is within the source threshold: {{offer, number}} days for catalogs, {{registry, number}} for registries.
hints.searchable: Not marked unavailable and linked to a company (lexical channel).
hints.priced: Commercial offers (directory, website, feed, price list) with a price set.

attention.title: Needs attention
attention.none: Nothing needs attention in this snapshot.
attention.source_stale: {{name}}: {{count, number}} of {{total, number}} offers are past the freshness threshold
attention.no_category: {{count, number}} of {{total, number}} offers have no category
attention.no_verified_seller: No offer has a verified seller

categories.title: Categories (OKPD2)
categories.companiesNote: A company can appear in several categories, so the rows add up to more than the unique total.

quality.ageNote: Buckets are exclusive: up to 1 day, 1 to 7, 7 to 30, over 30 days. Whether an item is overdue is judged by its source's threshold, not by these buckets.
quality.matrixNote: Every number links to the offers behind it.

sources.title: Sources
sources.runsSuccess: Fully successful runs in {{days, number}} days
sources.errorHidden: Error details are available to the operator.
sources.stateNote: Disabled, never run and failed are different states; a source switched off in settings looks like never run here.

records.title: Records behind the figure
records.description: Offers that explain the number you came from.
records.changed: {{count, number}} records changed after this snapshot. Refresh the analytics to see them.

state.empty: The catalog has no offers yet
state.emptyDescription: Run a source sync, then the figures appear here.
state.emptyFilterDescription: Reset the filters or choose another source.
state.partial: Some data could not be loaded
